review_candidates.title: Unpaid Technology Internships
review_candidates.description: About the Internship Mara7el is looking for motivated trainees and fresh graduates who are excited to learn, build, and grow with a technology-focused education startup. This internship is designed for individuals who want to gain practical experience by working on real product tasks, collaborating with a team, and using modern technologies and AI-assisted tools responsibly. We are opening three internship tracks: Junior Full-Stack Developer / Trainee. Junior QA Engineer / Trainee. Junior AI Engineer / Trainee. The internship will last for three months . Based on performance, progress, commitment, and business needs, successful trainees may have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role after completing the internship. Available Internship Tracks1. Junior Full-Stack Developer / Trainee As a Junior Full-Stack Developer, you will help build and improve the Mara7el platform while learning modern software-development practices. Main Responsibilities Build responsive web interfaces using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and JavaScript. Develop and integrate backend services and REST APIs. Work with PostgreSQL databases and SQL queries. Fix bugs and improve application performance and usability. Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code. Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaboration. Use Docker to manage development environments. Use AI coding assistants while developing, reviewing, and validating code. Participate in planning, technical discussions, and team reviews. Requirements Fresh graduate, final-year student, or trainee in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Good understanding of JavaScript and basic knowledge of TypeScript. Familiarity with React and Next.js. Basic understanding of backend development and REST APIs. Basic knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and PostgreSQL. Familiarity with Git and GitHub. Basic understanding of Docker. Ability to debug problems and learn new technologies. Good communication and teamwork skills. A portfolio, GitHub profile, or university project is preferred. Nice to Have Experience building or deploying a complete web application. Familiarity with authentication, authorization, or application security. Experience with automated testing. Familiarity with cloud platforms or CI/CD. Previous experience with AI-assisted development tools. 2. Junior QA Engineer / Trainee As a Junior QA Engineer, you will help ensure that the Mara7el platform is reliable, accurate, and easy to use. You will perform manual testing, document issues clearly, and gradually learn to build automated browser tests using Playwright. Main Responsibilities Review product requirements and identify test scenarios. Create and execute manual test cases and checklists. Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing. Test web applications across browsers and screen sizes. Report bugs with clear descriptions, evidence, and reproduction steps. Verify bug fixes and monitor recurring issues. Build and maintain automated browser tests using Playwright and AI-assisted tools. Validate application data using SQL and database queries. Test APIs and verify expected responses and error handling. Collaborate with developers to improve quality and test coverage. Maintain testing documentation and quality reports. Requirements Fresh graduate, final-year student, or trainee in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Good understanding of software-testing concepts. Strong attention to detail. Structured approach to problem-solving. Ability to write clear test cases and bug reports. Basic understanding of databases and SQL. Basic knowledge of APIs and API-testing tools. Familiarity with using AI tools to support testing. Good written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to learn test automation and modern QA practices. Nice to Have Basic knowledge of JavaScript. Familiarity with Playwright. Experience testing a web application. Familiarity with Git and GitHub. Experience with PostgreSQL. Familiarity with API-testing tools. Knowledge of performance, accessibility, or security testing. A testing portfolio, sample test plan, or automation project. 3. Junior AI Engineer / Trainee As a Junior AI Engineer, you will help research, build, and evaluate AI features for the Mara7el platform. Your work may include speech recognition, sentiment analysis, emotion detection, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and model evaluation or fine-tuning. Main Responsibilities Prepare, clean, label, and analyze text and audio datasets. Research and experiment with automatic speech-recognition models. Develop sentiment-analysis and emotion-detection solutions. Build applications and workflows using large language models. Create RAG pipelines using documents, embeddings, vector search, and LLMs. Assist with model fine-tuning and evaluation. Compare models using quality, speed, and cost metrics. Build prototypes and integrate AI capabilities into applications and APIs. Document experiments, results, limitations, and recommendations. Monitor AI outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, and safety. Follow relevant developments in NLP, speech, and generative AI. Requirements Fresh graduate, final-year student, or trainee in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Good knowledge of Python. Basic understanding of machine-learning and deep-learning concepts. Familiarity with natural-language processing. Basic knowledge of LLMs, embeddings, prompting, and RAG. Familiarity with at least one machine-learning framework or AI ecosystem. Ability to prepare datasets and evaluate model performance. Basic understanding of APIs, Git, and collaborative development. Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills. Ability to explain technical findings clearly. A university project, research project, portfolio, or GitHub repository related to AI or machine learning. Nice to Have Experience with Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar tools. Familiarity with speech-processing or ASR models. Experience with vector databases and semantic search. Knowledge of LoRA, PEFT, or other fine-tuning techniques. Familiarity with Arabic NLP or multilingual AI models. Experience deploying an AI model or exposing it through an API. Basic knowledge of Docker, cloud services, or GPU environments. What We Value Across all three tracks, we value: Curiosity and a strong willingness to learn. Ownership and reliability. Clear communication and respectful teamwork. Attention to quality and detail. Ability to receive feedback and continuously improve. Responsible use of AI tools and careful validation of their outputs. Important Information This is an unpaid internship . The internship duration is three months . The internship is suitable for trainees, final-year students, and fresh graduates. Full-time employment may be offered after the internship based on performance, progress, commitment, and business needs. Applicants may apply for one track or clearly indicate their preferred track. Please include your CV and, if available, your GitHub profile, portfolio, university project, testing samples, or AI/ML project.
